title: The Cycle Double Cover Conjecture
exact_target: Can every graph with no bridge have its edges covered by a list of cycles so that each edge appears exactly twice?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 59 (GT-004). CC BY 4.0.
Sang-il Oum, A Proof of the Cycle Double Cover Conjecture by OpenAI: An Exposition, arXiv:2607.16356v3 (2026), Section 1, definitions and Theorem 1; Section 3 on loops and repeated cycles.
